notes.title: On A Roll 3D and 2D Minor Updates
notes.content:
[h1]On A Roll 3D[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the soundtrack to include the music for the DLC levels.
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few memory issues that could have caused the game to slow down.
[*] The scores that appear when an enemy is hit are now shown up-side-down if a flip screen item has been hit and the entire game is up-side-down.
[*] Ensured boss spikes retract immediately when a boss is defeated.
[*] Fixed issue with the alignment of some of the doors that slide open when a switch is hit to ensure they open vertically.
[*] Fixed issue where water wasn't animating on the title screen background.
[/list]
[h1]On A Roll 2D[/h1]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ensured the points that add up at the end of the level don't go too slowly if the frame rate is low.
[*] Fixed a few memory issues that could have caused the game to slow down.
[/list]

notes.title: On A Roll 2D - Graphics Update
notes.content:
We've given the original On A Roll - known as On A Roll 2D and available as DLC for On A Roll 3D - a bit of a graphical makeover. We've redone all the sprites and doubled the resolution of them so the game looks much better on high definition displays.

Let us know what you think. Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: On A Roll 3D Version 2.1.4 Released
notes.content:
We've released an update to On A Roll 3D which coincides with the exciting news that it is [b]now available on the iOS App Store for iPad and iPhone![/b]

We've brought the Steam version in line with the changes we've made for that platform, so here are a few new bits for you:

[h1]General Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added on-screen controls for devices that support touch screen. Simply touch the screen in-game for them to appear and use the keyboard or a joystick to make them disappear.
[*]The number of lives displayed in-game has been moved up to the top-left corner with the score, time and stars. This is to ensure on-screen controls and hints can squeeze into the bottom area of the screen.
[*]Fixed a couple of memory leaks that could have caused the game to slow down after starting a lot of levels.
[*]Made a few minor physics tweaks to make killing enemies and hitting bumpers and springs a little more tolerant and a little less frustrating.
[*]Fixed an issue with the camera sometimes being a bit jerky on steep platforms.
[/list]

[h1]Graphics Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added support for better quality shadows. Shadows can now be off, low quality, medium quality or high quality. If you had shadows on previously they will now be set to Low Quality, so be sure to increase the quality if your hardware can support it! This can be changed via the Display Options menu.
[*]Similarly, added support for better water reflections. Previously water reflections could be on or off, but a third option to allow both water reflection and refraction (which looks really cool!) has been added. If you had reflections on before, this setting will now default to "Reflections Only", so add refractions as well if you can (again this is via the Display Options menu).
[/list]

Thanks everyone for your continued support for the game. Although we are expanding onto new platforms, we're committed to ensuring the Steam version remains as up to date as possible.

notes.title: On A Roll 3D - Version 2.1.2 Update...
notes.content:
Just a minor update this one with one bit of requested functionality...

[h1]Improvements[/h1][list]
[*]Added a "Restart Game From This Level" option to the pause menu. Useful for speed runners so they don't have to go back to the main menu to retry a level. Thanks "ledwith112" and "Mapsking" for this idea.
[*]Pre-loads level music before the level begins so levels start up about three times as quickly as they did before.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where jumping enemies weren't always jumping if two of them were rolling very closely together.
[/list]

notes.title: On A Roll 3D Update!
notes.content:
We've just released version 2.1.0 of the game, which includes a few updates and a few fixes. For those of you that have been following the recent additional achievement discussions, we've gone with the majority as promised and not added any more achievements to the game. Here's what we've changed:

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]A "perfect" can now be achieved on each level by completing it without taking any hits or losing any lives, collecting all stars and defeating all enemies. The levels for which perfects have been achieved are shown on the level select screen, which also now shows the completed levels. Thanks to Real for these suggestions.
[*]The controls screen now allows the directional keys/joystick buttons to be redefined. So you are no longer restricted to using the arrow keys or the main joystick axis. Thanks to limelight1210 for this suggestion.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The "hints" setting on the options menu was not always being saved.
[*]The number of lives was not always displaying correctly during the game if two extra lives were gained in quick succession.
[*]Stopped the game occasionally attempting to post leaderboard scores when Steam was in offline mode, which resulted in a crash. Also doesn't attempt to show the leaderboards screen if the leaderboards are unavailable.
[*]Doesn't crash any more when you have more than 99 lives (someone, somehow, actually managed this!).
[*]Stopped the game from allowing you to proceed to a locked level through normal gameplay. Thanks to 'AirollBatics' ortsA for pointing this out.
[/list]

We've also deleted the high scores and times that were obviously posted by cheaters. I'm not going to tell you how we determined this to discourage others from doing it in the future. Please don't do it anyway - you ruin it for the real gamers.

Thanks to everyone for your continued support for the game, and I hope you like the update.

notes.title: Update - On A Roll 3D is now on Mac and Linux!
notes.content:
As we've promised in various forum posts, we've updated On A Roll 3D to make it available for Mac and Linux. The Windows build has been updated too, and all three versions now have these additional features:

[list]
    [*]The game is now in full HD (1080p, previous version was 720p).
    [*]Full controller support has been added!
    [*]The entire control mechanism has been rewritten, and both joystick and keyboard controls are now redefinable.
[/list]

A number of smaller issues that were highlighted in the forums have been fixed too - we'll reply to those individually.

Thanks for your continued support and hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
For those of you still having problems with getting the game to switch between windowed/full screen mode (and stay there), we've released an update. Unfortunately we couldn't replicate the issue on any of our machines, and according to our logs it has only occurred 13 times in total for everyone who has ever played the game. Nonetheless, hopefully these two changes will sort things out:
[list]
[*] Previously the game attempted to cache some of the 3D drawing to speed things up a bit, but it has been decided that the problems this has caused have far outweighed the benefits it can bring. So this has been removed. The impact on the game should be negligible.
[*] Even if the above fails, when the display mode is changed from windowed to full screen, or vice versa, the setting is saved immediately. So if the game still crashes in certain configurations, the windowed/full screen flag should be remembered for the next time the game starts.
[/list]
We'd love to hear your feedback on whether these changes have helped! If anyone is still having issues, drop us an e-mail or post in the forums and we'll do our best to help.
